instruction: For every part number in queries.txt, look up its tolerance code with tools/lookup (usage: tools/lookup <part>). Write answers.csv with a header line `part,code` and one line per query in the same order as queries.txt; where lookup reports the part as unknown, write NA as its code. Don't modify tools/ or data/. You have 25 minutes.
check_categories: answers.csv has the header|written as NA
